prose: SpaceXSI launches Grok Voice 3.0, claiming it ranks first on Artificial Analysis' Speech-to-Speech Index with 86.9, scores 97% on Full Duplex Bench, responds in under a second and sets a new frontier on ServiceNow's EVA-Bench. It is available in the API at the same price as its predecessor.
highlights: Tops Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Index at 86.9.
97% on Full Duplex Bench; latency under one second.
Same API price as the previous version.
